content.short: REAP allows web3 projects to spend crypto like fiat and manage business finances on one platform.
content.description: REAP is a financial platform that blends spend management software with a suite of payment products to support businesses of all sizes. Its flagship VISA corporate card removes the merchant-acceptance barrier for B2B expenses and helps projects stay ahead of the market. With REAP, organizations can issue cards globally, pay salaries, conduct cross-border transactions, off-ramp using a fiat-denominated corporate card, and settle balances in digital currency—all within one platform.
content.meta: REAP enables web3 projects to spend crypto like fiat and manage business finances on one platform. Discover REAP and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
